    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# Step 1: Import required libraries\n",
        "\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error, r2_score\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Libraries imported successfully!\")\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "MbKaFGtFBBa4",
        "outputId": "c6989fc4-6013-427c-d980-5b0f5a8d727d"
      },
      "execution_count": 3,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Libraries imported successfully!\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# Step 2: Create sample historical sales data\n",
        "\n",
        "np.random.seed(42)\n",
        "\n",
        "dates = pd.date_range(\n",
        "    start=\"2021-01-01\",\n",
        "    periods=60,\n",
        "    freq=\"MS\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "trend = np.arange(60) * 80\n",
        "seasonal = 500 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * np.arange(60) / 12)\n",
        "noise = np.random.normal(0, 250, 60)\n",
        "\n",
        "sales = 5000 + trend + seasonal + noise\n",
        "\n",
        "df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    \"Date\": dates,\n",
        "    \"Sales\": sales\n",
        "})\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Dataset loaded successfully!\")\n",
        "print(df.head())\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "d7qkq7IkBCw4",
        "outputId": "c70adc1a-5967-4c0c-8e25-9bd5c3bf1999"

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# Step 4: Clean the dataset\n",
        "\n",
        "# Convert Date into datetime format\n",
        "df[\"Date\"] = pd.to_datetime(df[\"Date\"], errors=\"coerce\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Convert Sales into numeric format\n",
        "df[\"Sales\"] = pd.to_numeric(df[\"Sales\"], errors=\"coerce\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Remove rows with missing Date or Sales\n",
        "df = df.dropna(subset=[\"Date\", \"Sales\"])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Remove duplicate dates\n",
        "df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=[\"Date\"])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Sort data chronologically\n",
        "df = df.sort_values(\"Date\").reset_index(drop=True)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Data cleaning completed!\")\n",
        "print(\"Missing values:\\n\", df.isnull().sum())\n",
        "print(\"\\nCleaned dataset:\")\n",
        "print(df.head())\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "F-MkTF1iBM5h",
        "outputId": "f3861fb7-ebb0-490e-da98-91582c763d7d"

    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# Step 5: Plot historical sales\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(df[\"Date\"], df[\"Sales\"], marker=\"o\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"Historical Monthly Sales\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Date\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Sales\")\n",
        "plt.grid(True)\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {

          "height": 507
        },
        "id": "RhhDBx1MBPzI",
        "outputId": "6d47cf1e-9e13-4afd-9e6f-14aa1e14e9c5"

      "execution_count": 7,

        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# Step 6: Create features\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"Month_Index\"] = np.arange(len(df))\n",
        "\n",
        "X = df[[\"Month_Index\"]]\n",
        "y = df[\"Sales\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Input features (X):\")\n",
        "print(X.head())\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nTarget values (y):\")\n",
        "print(y.head())\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "VyAqcaGvBTyx",
        "outputId": "d14570dc-77e7-41f9-eb19-a172c370a8fe"
      },
      "execution_count": 8,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Input features (X):\n",
            "   Month_Index\n",
            "0            0\n",
            "1            1\n",
            "2            2\n",
            "3            3\n",
            "4            4\n",
            "\n",
            "Target values (y):\n",
            "0    5124.178538\n",
            "1    5295.433925\n",
            "2    5754.934836\n",
            "3    6120.757464\n",
            "4    5694.474358\n",
            "Name: Sales, dtype: float64\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# Step 7: Split data chronologically\n",
        "\n",
        "test_months = 12\n",
        "\n",
        "train = df.iloc[:-test_months].copy()\n",
        "test = df.iloc[-test_months:].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "X_train = train[[\"Month_Index\"]]\n",
        "y_train = train[\"Sales\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "X_test = test[[\"Month_Index\"]]\n",
        "y_test = test[\"Sales\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Training records:\", len(train))\n",
        "print(\"Testing records:\", len(test))\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "qAptJYgFBW-T",
        "outputId": "2cc2d273-f658-4c8f-95a1-2d2b0fe4fba8"
      },
      "execution_count": 9,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Training records: 48\n",
            "Testing records: 12\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# Step 8: Train Linear Regression model\n",
        "\n",
        "model = LinearRegression()\n",
        "\n",
        "model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Machine Learning model trained successfully!\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Model coefficient:\", model.coef_[0])\n",
        "print(\"Model intercept:\", model.intercept_)\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "78gPZi2jBZUS",
        "outputId": "009232a2-c11c-4d1b-ceb5-79315229e2cd"
      },
      "execution_count": 10,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Machine Learning model trained successfully!\n",
            "Model coefficient: 72.4802436474459\n",
            "Model intercept: 5125.38993367558\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# Step 9: Predict sales for the test period\n",
        "\n",
        "y_pred = model.predict(X_test)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Evaluate the model\n",
        "mae = mean_absolute_error(y_test, y_pred)\n",
        "rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred))\n",
        "r2 = r2_score(y_test, y_pred)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"MODEL EVALUATION\")\n",
        "print(\"----------------\")\n",
        "print(f\"MAE  : {mae:.2f}\")\n",
        "print(f\"RMSE : {rmse:.2f}\")\n",
        "print(f\"R² Score: {r2:.3f}\")\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "-ngPhHLvBbny",

        }

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",

        "\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# Step 11: Forecast future sales\n",
        "\n",
        "last_index = int(df[\"Month_Index\"].max())\n",
        "\n",
        "future_dates = pd.date_range(\n",
        "    start=df[\"Date\"].max() + pd.offsets.MonthBegin(1),\n",
        "    periods=12,\n",
        "    freq=\"MS\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "future_data = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    \"Date\": future_dates,\n",
        "    \"Month_Index\": np.arange(\n",
        "        last_index + 1,\n",
        "        last_index + 13\n",
        "    )\n",
        "})\n",
        "\n",
        "future_data[\"Predicted_Sales\"] = model.predict(\n",
        "    future_data[[\"Month_Index\"]]\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"NEXT 12 MONTHS SALES FORECAST\")\n",
        "print(future_data.round(2))\n"
      ],

            "application/javascript": [
              "\n",
              "    async function download(id, filename, size) {\n",
              "      if (!google.colab.kernel.accessAllowed) {\n",
              "        return;\n",
              "      }\n",
              "      const div = document.createElement('div');\n",
              "      const label = document.createElement('label');\n",
              "      label.textContent = `Downloading \"${filename}\": `;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(label);\n",
              "      const progress = document.createElement('progress');\n",
              "      progress.max = size;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(progress);\n",
              "      document.body.appendChild(div);\n",
              "\n",
              "      const buffers = [];\n",
              "      let downloaded = 0;\n",
              "\n",
              "      const channel = await google.colab.kernel.comms.open(id);\n",
              "      // Send a message to notify the kernel that we're ready.\n",
              "      channel.send({})\n",
              "\n",
              "      for await (const message of channel.messages) {\n",
              "        // Send a message to notify the kernel that we're ready.\n",
              "        channel.send({})\n",
              "        if (message.buffers) {\n",
              "          for (const buffer of message.buffers) {\n",
              "            buffers.push(buffer);\n",
              "            downloaded += buffer.byteLength;\n",
              "            progress.value = downloaded;\n",
              "          }\n",
              "        }\n",
              "      }\n",
              "      const blob = new Blob(buffers, {type: 'application/binary'});\n",
              "      const a = document.createElement('a');\n",
              "      a.href = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n",
              "      a.download = filename;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(a);\n",
              "      a.click();\n",
              "      div.remove();\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  "
            ]
          },
          "metadata": {}
        },

        "# Predictive Analytics Using Historical Data\n",
        "\n",
        "**Objective:** To build a Machine Learning model that analyzes historical sales data and forecasts future sales trends.\n",
        "\n",
        "**Tools Used:** Python, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn.\n",
        "\n",
        "**Methodology:**\n",
        "1. Created and explored historical monthly sales data.\n",
        "2. Cleaned the dataset and prepared date-based features.\n",
        "3. Split the data chronologically into training and testing sets.\n",
        "4. Trained a Linear Regression model.\n",
        "5. Evaluated the model using MAE, RMSE, and R² score.\n",
        "6. Visualized actual sales, predicted sales, and future forecasts.\n",
        "\n",
        "**Conclusion:** The project demonstrates how Machine Learning can use historical data to identify trends and estimate future sales.
